summary: Verified live Twilio SMS pipeline end-to-end for Rox Taxi. 6/6 pytest tests passed. Confirmed (a) direct Twilio POST /Messages returns 201 and reaches status=delivered on +12428039170, (b) POST /api/bookings with payment_method=zelle triggers notifications.notify_booking_confirmed which sends a live SMS delivered to +12428039170 with body containing booking id, item_name, and booking_date, (c) SMTP fallback path (mail.privateemail.com) executes without exception, (d) empty customer_phone is a safe no-op that does not raise. Sample booking SID observed this run: SM84e534b0fa7bb6329405813861509827 (delivered, no error_code) for booking AA38B59D.

minor.issue: send_sms swallows the Twilio SID and status — caller has no way to log/audit delivery outcome. Consider returning the Message resource or at least the sid so /api/bookings can log it.

Runs synchronously inside the POST /api/bookings request path for Zelle bookings. A slow Twilio/SMTP call will block the HTTP response (observed ~1–3s added latency). Consider FastAPI BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task for fire-and-forget dispatch.
SMTP_PASSWORD is committed in plaintext in /app/backend/.env and Twilio auth token is also in cleartext. Not a test failure, but worth flagging for prod deployment (use secrets manager).

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Return Twilio message SID from send_sms so booking creation can persist/log the SID for audit.
(Optional) Move notify_booking_confirmed into a FastAPI BackgroundTask so the /api/bookings response is not blocked by Twilio/SMTP round-trips.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.send_sms return type ignores Twilio's response — no observability into delivery/failure. Recommend returning (True, message.sid) or the Message object.
server.py POST /api/bookings runs Twilio + SMTP synchronously for Zelle path (line 578-582). Should use BackgroundTasks to avoid blocking HTTP response.
server.py file is 1625 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split (bookings, payments, admin, config, etc.).

Twilio trial limitation: only verified caller IDs receive SMS. Production should either upgrade Twilio to paid or add a runtime check + friendly error surfacing when Twilio returns error_code 21608 (unverified number on trial).
test_credentials: admin@roxtaxi.com / admin123 (not needed for this iteration — SMS pipeline tests are unauthenticated).
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway booking (payment_method=zelle, customer_phone=+12428039170) per run. Booking IDs are 8-char UUIDs prefixed with 'TEST' names/emails; not deleted afterwards. Recommend a periodic cleanup of bookings with customer_email LIKE 'TEST_%'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The SMS pipeline works reliably against Twilio trial ONLY for the verified caller ID +12428039170. Do NOT change the phone number in tests to a random one — Twilio trial will return error_code 21608 (unverified) and delivery will fail. When adding new bookings/payment flow tests, prefer payment_method='zelle' (fires notify_booking_confirmed synchronously) rather than 'stripe' (fires via _mark_paid webhook path which requires a real Stripe session).

live_delivery_evidence.direct_api_test: Twilio POST /Messages 201 -> polled GET /Messages/{sid} until status in {delivered,failed,undelivered}; observed status=delivered, error_code=None.
live_delivery_evidence.booking_flow_test: Booking AA38B59D -> SMS SID SM84e534b0fa7bb6329405813861509827 -> status=delivered, error_code=None. Body: 'Rox Taxi: Booking AA38B59D confirmed for Airport Pickup TEST on 2026-07-30. Total $45.00. Track: roxtaxi.com/track?id=AA38B59D'
